sql: select strategy, status, count(*), max(created_at) from live_orders where strategy in ('Hmmsell10','Jmmsell10') and (created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes' or status in ('resting','pending','submitted','partial')) group by 1,2 union all select strategy, 'paper', count(*), max(created_at) from paper_trades where strategy in ('Jmmsell10','Jmmsell10_pt4','Hmmsell10') and created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes' group by 1
